title: A Universal Interfacial Strategy for Suppressing Aluminum Corrosion by Confining H⁺/OH⁻ Dynamics in Aqueous Energy Storage System
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06040K, Paper
Yuwei Long, Yiheng Qi, Chuang Bao, Xuanchi Li, Kefa Cen, Jianhua Yan, Bo Zheng, Huachao Yang
Aqueous electrochemical energy storage (EES) systems offer promise for large-scale applications, yet their practical deployment is fundamentally constrained by the persistent corrosion of aluminum current collector (AlCC) in aqueous environments....
